verdict.rationale: Formant documents Docker-based agent install for ROS1/ROS2 devices and claims robots connect 'with minimal lift'. It supports configuration export to YAML or reusable templates, and offers peer-to-peer teleop and commands such as publish_ros_topic that could drive first motion. However, it onboards an already-working robot stack onto a fleet platform rather than providing hardware drivers or bring-up tooling, and nothing shows bring-up time dropping from weeks to hours. Missing for 10: robot driver/hardware bring-up support, evidence of an hours-scale bring-up workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
